card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables and ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit (mostly 2, 3, 5 or 1) that sits inside or at the start of a number in a dose table, dosimetry table or numeric range. It often comes just before a decimal point, comma or 'to'.

modes.label: Dosimetry and dose tables
modes.description: Digit in a cell of a table of organ doses or weight-based dose amounts.

modes.label: Start of a range
modes.description: Digit at the start or inside a number that opens a 'to' range in dosing or half-life text.
modes.example: The half-life of midazolam increased from <<5>> to 7 hours

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number in dose tables and ranges.
